novels.author: JumboJack
novels.title: The Dark Lord's Presence
novels.description:
It is awful to be trapped with no way of escaping; it is even worse to be in a trap of your own making. You know this story, you have heard it several times before, but this the ending and the beginning are different, just for the hell of it. Our hero has no name, he has lost it along his journey, the only thing that is left is a story and a warning.

I’ve seen the time loop regression setup done so many times in anime that I thought I would write my own take on the scenario and post it here. Spoilers; only expect the unexpected. I’m looking for constructive criticism, since this is the first time I have published a story online, thank you and I hope you enjoy it.

novels.title: Moon Clip
novels.description:
Death was sudden and violent.

Then, he opened his eyes.

No scars. No heaven. Just a suffocating, incomprehensible world.

Pluto finds himself dragged into a court of eccentric elites where the rules make no sense, and polite smiles hide quiet cruelties. There is no time to process the trauma of his own murder. Instead, he is given a seat at the table and expected to survive the bizarre, dangerous routines of his new life.

The physical wounds are gone, but his mind remembers. In a place where madness is perfectly normal, keeping his sanity might be harder than coming back from the dead.

novels.author: arthur guerins
novels.title: the Dawn of Fifth Age - Part 1. the Witches of Timskit
novels.description:
The erudite Enton Amchworth ponders the future of the world:

"The First Age, the one before the arrival of men, the age of the ancient world. It was filled with fantastic and primitive creatures, powerful and voracious. Most were driven by magic. In fact, everything was magic. Little by little, humans carved out their place and drove out these malevolent beings. Or rather, malevolent to them."

"This was the Second Age. Clans formed based on each member's proficiency in wielding certain types of magic. But, intoxicated by the power of the art they were learning to master, they eventually turned on each other and fought. No one won, but there were so many deaths that the Dark Age returned."

"Then came the third age, the age of ferocious and fantastic beasts. They returned from the eastern and northern borders, from the Tentra mountain range and the Mother of Dagor. Humans were able to unite once more to reconquer the lost territories."

"Here we are in the Fourth Age, the age when humankind grew wise and maintained peace until this day. They kept each other in check, forged alliances, and maintained constant diplomacy between each country, between each magical realm. Even between east and west, despite the mountain that separates them. It was the golden age of magic. Lords and magical eminences were more numerous and moved freely from one country to another. Then their numbers diminished . Today, they hide. Or rather, what remains of them since dark clouds have covered the world. Since the day hostilities have arisen between vassals, since bands of brigands have more regularly roamed the countryside, and spies and assassins have prowled the land. Glairbor is a powerful mage, and he wields a forgotten and forbidden magic. His evil hand is inexorably spreading across the inhabitants of every country, and this war is poised to devastate the Old World. It is likely to be a long one. Unexplored territories will soon no longer be pacified, the beasts may return, and the world will change once more. I believe we are entering the Fifth Age."

At the beginning of these events, a young miraculous amnesiac orphan girl, begins her initiation as a new recruit of the Night Witches. Her strength, independence, and thirst for justice will lead her to encounter exceptional individuals with unique destinies. They unite and, in a formidable epic, they carry hope, love, and their faith in their convictions to the far reaches of the Old World, thus taking part in the birth of the Fifth Age.

novels.author: LionKimbro
novels.description:
October, 1985. A boy and his little sister find ten mysterious VHS tapes slipped into their family’s living room shelf. The labels are too clean, too sharp—letters etched with a precision no home tape ever had.

Curiosity wins. They play the first tape.

The screen comes alive with a strange green glow, a computer program from the future, a movie unlike anything they’ve ever seen. Police who move like ghosts. A woman in black who runs on walls. None of it belongs to 1985.

What begins as a secret between siblings doesn’t stay secret for long. Because the tapes aren’t just at their house. They’re turning up everywhere—on professors’ desks, in libraries, in places of power. And once seen, they can’t be unseen.

History is about to change.

1985/2025 is a speculative sci-fi drama about curiosity, awe, and what happens when an entire civilization is given a glimpse of its possible future. What would you do if you saw the decades to come—your hopes, your mistakes, your doom—before they ever happened?

novels.author: AzraVerse99
novels.title: Welcome to 2080
novels.description:
In the year 2080, the world has evolved into a hyper-technological society where memory cloning, optical computing, and synthetic biology are commonplace. Surveillance is omnipresent, and human value is measured by utility. Amid this landscape, Marcus, a legendary ethical hacker, reflects on the cost of progress and the fading traces of those who shaped it.

Haunted by the memory of a mentor who once taught him that “code is never neutral,” Marcus embarks on a quiet journey to understand the ethical foundations of a world that has traded meaning for efficiency. Through therapy sessions, cryptic encounters, and philosophical dialogues, he revisits the legacy of a forgotten professor — a pioneer in memory architecture who vanished from public life after revolutionizing light-based computation.

As Marcus navigates a society obsessed with advancement, he confronts the central question: Is scientific progress worth it if it erodes the soul of humanity? The answer, buried in the professor’s final project, is chillingly clear:

“Ethics matter more. Otherwise, memories become commodities.”

This introspective sci-fi tale blends philosophy, technology, and emotional depth, exploring the tension between innovation and morality. It’s a story of ghosts — not the supernatural kind, but the brilliant minds who chose silence over spectacle, and whose quiet warnings echo through the future.

novels.author: GsWriter
novels.title: Frieden
novels.description:
Caught in the most cliché death imaginable, a man wakes up in the body of his own RPG character: wrong genre, wrong world, wrong everything! Stranded in a port city in the country of Albion with nothing but a dying smartphone and clothes that don't fit his new body, Caster stumbles into ownership of a crumbling pleasure house—and everything chained in its basement.

In a world where demi-humans are enslaved and humans don't spare them a second glance, survival means learning the rules of a society built on cruelty. Between rebuilding a ruined business, navigating a magic system he never asked for, and earning the trust of those the world has already thrown away, Caster has to decide what kind of person he'll become—and whether surviving this world means becoming part of its cruelty, or finding a way to break it.

novels.author: Leave
novels.title: The Forgotten Art
novels.description:
In a land ruled by kings and bound by chains, magic is more than forbidden—it is despised. Once, mages held the world in their grasp, but their cruelty sparked a rebellion that burned every grimoire and shattered every tower. What remains are broken kingdoms, iron laws, and fields where slaves toil beneath watchful spears.

Rat, a nameless boy raised in chains, has never known freedom, only hunger, fear, and the weight of his own self-doubt. His days are measured in corn husks and lash marks, his nights in whispers of powers long destroyed. But when chance uncovers a book thought lost to fire, Rat stands at the edge of a secret that could damn him—or change the world.

The kings fear magic. The people loathe it. Rat barely understands it. Yet in his hands lies the forgotten art, and with it, the question that has cursed his life from the start: can anything born in chains ever be free?

novels.title: Undefined Conviction
novels.description:
Fear. Hatred. Ambition. Something they refuse to lose.

When a person awakens, that Conviction becomes power.

Cole Vale doesn't have one.

His assessment produces no rank, no measurable potential, and a result the system isn't supposed to possess:

UNDEFINED.

Cole would be perfectly happy being left alone. Unfortunately, breaking a machine designed to classify every awakened human on Earth attracts attention.

Government investigators want answers. Awakened organizations want to know what he is. And something that has watched the world for centuries has finally noticed him.

Because Cole may not be powerless.

He may be something the system was never designed to understand.

novels.author: Verrinen
novels.title: The Crypted Legacy (Abandoned)
novels.description:
Three years after the Fracture shattered Earth into fragmented realms, humanity clings to survival against monsters and chaos unleashed by the Core's descent. The System offers shards, crystalline fragments of power, but salvation comes at a cost.

Among the ruins, an abandoned boy discovers a rare Crypted Shard that grants him immortality at a brutal price. Transformed into something more than human, he is forced to confront a world that gave him nothing but pain. Driven by anger and an insatiable hunger for vengeance, his journey will unravel the secrets of the Core, challenge the remnants of humanity, and determine whether he becomes a savior or the ultimate harbinger of destruction.

In a world built on ruin, power is everything, and the boy must decide how far he’s willing to go.

Written by: Verrinen
